texts.text: Now... how will you react...?
Shinomiya thought for an instant...
But what went through her mind was no ordinary process of thought!
He's attacked me...
By revealing that he wants to see the movie, he's left the choice of whether to go or not up to me.
A fine counter- attack...
I have the option of refusing him,
But that would render all I've done up to this point meaning- less...
All I've done...
Carefully preparing a fake prize...
You can also find a
Slipping it into Fuiura's mailbox...
and finding a movie on a weekend on one of his rare breaks...!!
If I refuse him here, with his mental weakness,
He may very well never invite me to a movie again.
As a woman, I cannot allow that!
That is not an option!!
I cannot retreat!
You're right.
I do sort of believe it...
but I was hoping someone would give me a sincere invitation to see it...
Shinomiya used the skill "Feishing innocence!"
One of the secret techniques passed down from Father to Child in the Shinomiya family!
against this carefully calculated expression and sudden change in voice,
Even the heart of a God would be set allutter!
Shirogane's thoughts were thrown into disarray!!
